observations.note: Front face is well lit and fully visible; multiple fine scratches and scuff marks are present, while edges appear intact.
Angled view shows front face and one side edge; scratches and smudges are visible on the face, side edge shows no chipping.
Perspective view captures the full face; the same scratch/scuff pattern is visible, with no obvious edge or coating loss.
Viewed from the opposite end, the left-side scratch cluster and central smudge are clear; edges remain continuous.
Vertical orientation shows scratches in the middle and lower portions; no material missing along visible edges or face.

limitations: Only the visible front and partial side surfaces are assessed; the back and unseen edges are not photographed.
Lighting is soft and diffused, which may hide very shallow surface marks.
No macro or scale reference is available, so trace depth and exact size cannot be determined.
Surface smudges and reflections can resemble shallow scratches; no tactile or cross-sectional confirmation is possible.
